BL-1459 — A documenter briefing lands on main through a QA note inside its lane, once per day: check_documenter_briefing_tip.sh in the shared pre-merge-commit chain accepts a documenter commit that changes only docs/briefings/<date>.md (and its .json sidecar), refuses any other path - .sent.json first - and refuses a briefing for a day main already carries; before this the documenter's briefings reached main by cherry-pick (09-05), by hand (09-06) or not at all (human ruling A, 2026-09-07)
What it solves: Minted 2026-09-07 by the specifier, the same pass as the ruling, sibling
of BL-1458 (triggers). Prompt halves landed first (870d0153e6).
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options: this is the landing half of your ruling A (documenter authors; QA lands its commit on a note like the art director's). What is FIRM: the lane is the day's briefing file and its .json sidecar …
BL-1459 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1459" (or "reject BL-1459 <reason>") to act.
